title: Current calculation
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates current using I = q/t with given values.

title: Resistance calculation
description: Essential: Student correctly calculates resistance using R = Q/(I²t) with given values.

title: Joule's law application
description: Important: Student recognizes that heat generated Q relates to power via Q = I²Rt.

title: Unit consistency
description: Important: Student maintains consistent units (C, s, A, J, Ω) throughout calculations.

title: Algebraic manipulation
description: Optional: Student shows clear algebraic rearrangement from Q = I²Rt to R = Q/(I²t).

title: Incorrect current formula
description: Pitfall: Student uses incorrect formula for current (e.g., I = t/q or I = Q/t).

title: Power vs. energy confusion
description: Pitfall: Student confuses heat energy Q with power P, using P = I²R instead of Q = I²Rt.

title: Unit omission or mismatch
description: Pitfall: Student omits units in final answers or reports incorrect units (e.g., Ω as V/A without calculation).
